records.issue_text: app/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller.rb:15 — Deleting a host ID that no longer exists calls destroy on nil and raises a 500 instead of returning a not-found error.
records.rationale: Looking at the destroy action in app/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller.rb lines 14-17: `host = EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` followed by `host.destroy`. If the ID doesn't exist, `first` returns nil, and calling `destroy` on nil will raise a NoMethodError, resulting in a 500 error instead of a proper 404 not-found response. This is a real bug in the new code.

records.issue_text: app/assets/javascripts/admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6:46 — Failed host deletion has no rejection handler, so the admin receives no error feedback and the promise is left unhandled.
records.rationale: Looking at line 46 in embeddable-host.js.es6, the delete action calls `this.get('host').destroyRecord().then(...)` but there is no `.catch()` handler for the promise. If the destroyRecord fails (e.g., network error, server error), the promise rejection is unhandled and the user receives no feedback about the failure. This contrasts with the save action which properly uses `.catch(popupAjaxError)`
